properties.name: An approver missing from this design but known to a design it pins is named in the refusal, with the one call that records them here
properties.source: Anthony, 2026-10-09, dev_reflow2 hub (work field log triage)
properties.statement:
When a write names an approver that is not a Contributor in this design, and a design it declares (a hub pin or a member pin) that this server can read holds a Contributor with that id, the refusal shall say so: where the match was found, its name and kind, and the one add_contributor call that records it here. Nothing is written by the refusal, so an approver stays a name somebody chose to record (dec:idea-authentication-is-somebody-elses-layer-and-the-line-is-the-contributor-id). Measured case: fact:a-member-store-refuses-an-approver-its-hub-knows-because-contributors-live-in-one-store-2026-10-09.

Anthony, 2026-10-09, kept this as intent when asked which of the field log's four ideas to keep (he kept all four).
